answer: Write it down for the next maintainer: standing decays 4 percent per idle epoch, rewards vest over 100 epochs, and nothing unlocks before 30 days of continuous uptime. Then check the order of operations. Decay applies before vesting, so an idle week can eat more than a good month earns. Duplicate submissions forfeit the attestation that carried them. A farm at the wharf of registration gets no head start, because the clock starts after the first real job, not after the first key. Build the garden and keep it alive, the forge only pays for heat it still has.
